title: Niagara CANADA, Domed (Dry) Jet Boat Tour
includes: Souvenir photographs (available to purchase at end of trip) (not included)
We do not see Niagara Falls on any of our tours (not included)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels

Wheelchair accessibility - guests are able to use wheel chair onto the dock up to the boat, but cannot bring the chair on the boat. If assistance is required, passenger must provide their own carer. Guests must be able to sit on a bench seat and support themselves by holding on to a bar in-front of each seat without assistance.
Guests must arrive on site via their own form of transportation - Whirlpool Jet Boat Tours is not responsible for getting you to the dock.
There is a minimum height requirement of 40" tall for the DRY Freedom Jet seats. Children will be measured on-site, and those who do not meet the requirements will not be permitted to ride.
Guests under 18 years old are not permitted to ride without an adult chaperone (age 18+).
policies: Arrive promptly 45 minutes prior to departure time to register, sign participation agreement and hear pre-trip safety orientation. If you miss the safety orientation, we will move you to the next available trip time without notice (which could be the next day) so it is important to arrive on time.
The participation agreement thoroughly explains all pertinent aspects of jet-boating including personal health requirements. Refusal to sign the agreement will not merit a credit or refund.

Late or no-show participants will not receive a refund. You have 24 hours prior to your trip to cancel for a full refund. Trips can be rescheduled until day of the departure at no added charge (subject to availability).
*Please note that we do not see Niagara Falls from our tour*
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
All the thrills of a jet boat ride without getting wet! The Niagara Gorge Domed Jet Boat Ride speeds down the Niagara River and past 18 miles (29 km) of exhilarating scenery to the churning white waters of the famous Niagara Whirlpool. The covered boat keeps you dry as waves crash and splash around the domed jet boat! 

**Please note that we do not see Niagara Falls from our tour**
